info.title: MentalCraft Unified Plugin & Capability Architecture
info.description: Universal Agent-Less Capability & Domain Intelligence Architecture across 6 Core Subsystems (Workflow, Business, Science, Design, Chrome, Message)

servers.name: mentalcraft-gateway-http
servers.summary: Master MCP Gateway HTTP/SSE aggregation endpoint

methods.name: workflow
methods.summary: Cross-Plugin Orchestrator, Compound DAG Engine & Health Diagnostics
methods.description: Coordinates multi-plugin workflows, benchmarks latency percentiles (P50/P90/P99), traces OTel spans, and verifies system integrity.

action.description: Workflow action: 'list_workflows' (catalog of pipelines), 'run_workflow' (live execution), 'register_workflow' (define custom DAG), 'get_workflow_history' (past execution receipts), 'export_config' (generate MCP client JSON configs), 'install_mcp_schemas' (install to Antigravity), 'export_schema_catalog' / 'export_openrpc_spec' (OpenRPC 1.3.2 specification), 'export_openapi_catalog' / 'export_openapi_spec' (OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification), 'benchmark' (P50/P90/P99 latency & ops/sec suite across all 6 subsystems), 'get_metrics' (live telemetry and circuit breaker state), 'export_trace' (OTel spans export), 'export_mermaid_dag' (Mermaid diagram), 'batch_run' (pooled parallel execution), 'health_check' (system diagnostics), 'dry_run' (plan graph inspection).

client_target.description: Target IDE or agent client for export_config.

custom_workflow.description: Custom workflow definition object containing id, name, description, requiredPlugins, and steps.

tasks.description: List of concurrent tasks for batch_run action.

concurrency.description: Maximum concurrency pool limit for batch_run.

parameters.description: Optional custom parameters passed to workflow pipeline steps.

benchmark_options.description: Options for benchmark execution (iterations, warmupIterations, subsystems).

iterations.description: Number of benchmark iterations per target.

schema.description: Workflow execution receipt or diagnostic result

methods.name: business
methods.description: Market TAM/SAM/SOM validation, Sean Ellis PMF survey, SEO KD/ASO/Steam/TikTok acquisition, activation funnel, D1-D90 retention, unit economics (CAC/LTV/COGS/3PL), price elasticity, and 90-day growth playbooks.

action.description: Business action across the 8 venture lifecycle stages: Stage 1 Ideation ('venture_market_validation', 'market_niche_discovery'), Stage 2 PMF ('venture_pmf_validation'), Stage 3 Acquisition ('venture_acquisition_audit', SEO/TrafficCV actions), Stage 4 Activation ('venture_activation_funnel'), Stage 5 Retention ('venture_retention_curves'), Stage 6 Unit Economics ('venture_unit_economics', 'venture_monetization_telemetry', 'market_stripe_radar', 'market_site_trajectory', 'product_traction_score'), Stage 7 Pricing ('venture_pricing_experiment'), Stage 8 Scale & Moats ('venture_growth_playbook', 'venture_expansion_moat'), and 'list_actions'.

modality.description: Commercial modality of the venture: 'website' (SaaS/Web App), 'app' (iOS/Android mobile/desktop app), 'game' (Steam/mobile/console game), 'shop' (E-Commerce D2C / TikTok Shop / Amazon FBA). Default is 'website'.

venture_name.description: Name of the business venture or product.

keyword.description: Search keyword to analyze (e.g. 'anxiety test online', 'deckbuilder roguelike').

keywords.description: Array of keywords for batch evaluation.

domain.description: Domain name for Stripe billing trajectory or TrafficCV analytics.

domains.description: Array of domain names for TrafficCV competitor comparison.

competitors.description: List of competitor names or domains.

arpu.description: Average Revenue Per User in USD.

price_points.description: Array of price points to test in pricing elasticity experiment.

cogs.description: Cost of Goods Sold in USD (for e-commerce/shop ventures).

shipping_cost.description: 3PL Warehousing & Shipping cost per unit in USD.

lead_time_days.description: Supplier / factory reorder lead time in days.

daily_demand_units.description: Average daily demand / sales velocity in units.

demand_std_dev.description: Standard deviation of daily demand for safety stock calculation.

service_level_percent.description: Target inventory cycle service level percentage (e.g. 95 or 99).

pmf_score.description: Sean Ellis PMF score percentage (% very disappointed without product).

force.description: Bypass cache and force fresh SERP evaluation.

methods.name: science
methods.summary: 8-Stage Academic Production Lifecycle & Research Intelligence Engine
methods.description: Literature discovery, DOI BibTeX verify, methodology power audit (Cohen's d), NIH/NSF grant rubrics & F&A budgeting, LaTeX scaffolding, simulated 3-reviewer peer review, journal Impact Factor matching, and 35 U.S.C. patent audits.

action.description: Science intelligence action across the 8 academic production lifecycle stages: Stage 1 Literature ('paper_literature_search', 'paper_citation_verify'), Stage 2 Methodology ('paper_methodology_audit'), Stage 3 Grants ('grant_criteria_audit', 'grant_aims_alignment', 'grant_budget_calculator'), Stage 4 Authoring ('paper_structure_audit', 'paper_latex_scaffold'), Stage 5 Peer Review ('paper_peer_review_simulate'), Stage 6 Journal Submission ('journal_matcher', 'journal_submission_checklist'), Stage 7 Intellectual Property ('patent_novelty_check', 'patent_claim_structure', 'patent_spec_scaffold'), Stage 8 Scholarly Impact ('scholarly_impact_forecast'), and 'list_actions'.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for citation verification.

bibtex.description: Raw BibTeX entry string to validate and parse.

manuscript_title.description: Title of manuscript for audit, review simulation, LaTeX scaffolding, or impact forecast.

sections.description: Key-value dictionary mapping section names to text.

latex_template.description: LaTeX template type to generate ('acm' for SIGCONF, 'ieee' for Transactions/Journals).

methodology_data.description: Methodology parameters (sample_size, treatment_mean, control_mean, pooled_std, baselines).

direct_costs.description: Direct costs breakdown (personnel, equipment, supplies, travel, subawards_over_25k, participant_support, other).

annual_escalation_percent.description: Annual cost-of-living and merit escalation rate percentage (default: 3%).

target_review_weeks_max.description: Maximum acceptable average review turnaround time in weeks.

invention_title.description: Title of invention for patent novelty audit or spec scaffolding.

invention_summary.description: Invention summary or patent claim narrative.

claims_list.description: List of structured patent claims for antecedent basis verification.

methods.name: design
methods.summary: 5-Layer Design System, Runes UI Synthesis & On-Demand Subpaths
methods.description: Component catalog inspection, OKLCH design tokens, Svelte 5 runes UI generation (Hero, PDP, Screener, Pricing), A11y & token linter, and AST subpath tree-shaking.

action.description: Design action: 'catalog' (list components), 'inspect_component' (deep schema/props/example), 'theme_tokens' (colors, spacing, radius), 'generate_ui' (Svelte 5 runes recipe), 'audit_ui' (A11y/Token linter), 'bridge_chrome' (DOM to component mapper), 'list_layers' (5-layer architecture), 'resolve_imports' (calculate on-demand subpaths & savings), 'domain_presets' (clinical, chat_ai, analytics, commerce, auth, ecommerce_pdp, ecommerce_checkout, academic_manuscript_viewer, venture_telemetry_dashboard), 'bundle_optimize' (refactor monolithic imports).

components.description: List of component names for on-demand subpath resolution.

prompt.description: Free-form search term, component name, or UI generation description.

template_code.description: Svelte or HTML code snippet to audit against design system standards or optimize imports.

chrome_element.description: DOM element metadata from Chrome inspector for design system bridging.

limit.description: Maximum number of catalog items to return.

schema.description: Design system tokens or compiled component recipe

methods.name: chrome
methods.summary: Chrome Automation, Native Bridge & Inactive Tab Driving
methods.description: CDP inspection, DOM querying, HUD visual annotations, vitals profiling (LCP/CLS/FID), and mode-0600 cookie receipts.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Unified multi-channel message dispatch (Telegram > iMessage > Email) with mode-0600 credentials isolation.
